AssessmentBriefOut.description: One assessment in a list: where it stands and, once confirmed, its headline numbers.
AssessmentBriefOut.title: AssessmentBriefOut

AuditFiltersOut.description: What the log can be filtered by: the actions and the people that appear in it.
AuditFiltersOut.title: AuditFiltersOut

CompassOut.description: Everything the 12-segment compass draws, for one result on one scale.
CompassOut.title: CompassOut

CompassSegmentOut.description: One dimension of the compass, in book order.
CompassSegmentOut.title: CompassSegmentOut

ConsultantAccessOut.description: Access as the consultant sees it: waiting for them to accept, or active.
ConsultantAccessOut.title: ConsultantAccessOut

ConsultantGrantOut.description: A grant as the client's admin sees it.
ConsultantGrantOut.title: ConsultantGrantOut

ConsultantOrganisationOut.description: An organisation the user sees as a consultant, through accepted, live access.
ConsultantOrganisationOut.title: ConsultantOrganisationOut

DashboardOut.description: The two headline scores side by side, never combined (spec 4).
DashboardOut.title: DashboardOut

DimensionDetailOut.description: One dimension: the book's text, and its score on each scale, kept apart.
DimensionDetailOut.title: DimensionDetailOut

DimensionReviewOut.description: One dimension of an assessment: the AI's proposal beside the owner's final score.
DimensionReviewOut.title: DimensionReviewOut

ExplanationOut.description: An AI explanation of one question (touchpoint 1). Helps only; it holds no number.
ExplanationOut.title: ExplanationOut

IdeaChoiceOut.description: An idea with a confirmed IQ assessment, for the idea picker.
IdeaChoiceOut.title: IdeaChoiceOut

IdeaCreateIn.description:
A new idea: a title and summary are required; the currency defaults to the
organisation's.
IdeaCreateIn.title: IdeaCreateIn

IdeaStage.description:
How far an idea has come, in the idea owner's words. Context for the reader and the
AI; it changes no score.
IdeaStage.title: IdeaStage

IdeaStatus.description:
Where an idea is on its way to an IQ. Archiving is a separate flag (``archived_at``).

``draft`` is being written; ``submitted`` means the latest IQ assessment is proposed
but not confirmed; ``assessed`` means the latest assessment is confirmed. A re-assessment
moves an assessed idea back to ``submitted``; the confirmed assessment stays for history.
IdeaStatus.title: IdeaStatus

IdeaUpdateIn.description: Partial update: only the fields sent are changed. Send null to clear an optional one.
IdeaUpdateIn.title: IdeaUpdateIn

IqAssessmentStatus.description:
One IQ assessment of an idea, left to right.

``proposed``: the AI proposal is on its way or waiting for the owner's review (Amy Q1).
``confirmed``: the owner confirmed the 12 scores; scored by the engine and immutable.
``superseded``: replaced by a newer proposal before it was confirmed.
IqAssessmentStatus.title: IqAssessmentStatus

IqHeadlineOut.description: The selected idea's latest confirmed IQ assessment.
IqHeadlineOut.title: IqHeadlineOut

MembershipRole.description:
A user's role inside one organisation.

Platform staff are not a role here (``User.is_platform_admin``), and a consultant is
never a member (``ConsultantGrant``).
MembershipRole.title: MembershipRole

OrgRole.description: The caller's role in the active organisation: a membership role or ``consultant``.
OrgRole.title: OrgRole

OrganisationCreateIn.description: A new organisation: a name is required, the currency defaults to US dollars.
OrganisationCreateIn.title: OrganisationCreateIn

OrganisationUpdateIn.description: Partial update: only the fields sent are changed. Send null to clear an optional field.
OrganisationUpdateIn.title: OrganisationUpdateIn

ReadinessHeadlineOut.description: The organisation's latest final readiness result.
ReadinessHeadlineOut.title: ReadinessHeadlineOut

ReadinessStatus.description:
The life of a readiness assessment, left to right. It never moves backwards.

``draft`` is just created; ``collecting`` takes each person's answers; ``consensus``
is the facilitator setting the agreed answers (Amy Q5); ``final`` is scored and
immutable.
ReadinessStatus.title: ReadinessStatus

ReviewIn.description: The owner's review: changed scores (null puts the proposal back) and notes.
ReviewIn.title: ReviewIn

SegmentLevelOut.description:
The book's level of one IQ dimension score (spec 3.1). ``order`` is its place among
the levels, lowest first, so the compass can colour segments without knowing a level.
SegmentLevelOut.title: SegmentLevelOut

TargetScale.description: Which of the two scores a target is set on. They are never mixed (spec 4).
TargetScale.title: TargetScale

TargetScaleOut.description: One scale's targets. Readiness and IQ targets are separate and never mixed.
TargetScaleOut.title: TargetScaleOut

TargetsIn.description: Every target of one scale: a dimension left out (or null) has no target.
TargetsIn.title: TargetsIn

TrendPointOut.description:
One earlier or current score of a dimension, with its change from the result before
it on the same question set version (null when there is none to compare with).
TrendPointOut.title: TrendPointOut

VfmOut.description:
Value for Money (spec 5.1): the investment the assessment was confirmed with and the
cost per innovation point, or why there is none.
VfmOut.title: VfmOut

WeightsIn.description: Every dimension's weight. Numbers or decimal strings; the engine checks the limits.
WeightsIn.title: WeightsIn

get.description:
The organisation's recorded actions, newest first, optionally only one action or one
person. ``next_before`` is the cursor of the next page.

The same list as a CSV file (newest first, at most 5,000 rows), with the same
filters. Times are UTC.

post.description:
Ends the session in this browser, on the server too. Always clears the cookies; the
session is revoked and audited only with a valid session and a passing CSRF check.

get.description:
The two headline scores, kept apart: the latest final readiness result (out of 300,
with its band) and the IQ (out of 100) of the selected idea, each with its compass and
priorities. Without ``idea_id`` the most recently confirmed idea is selected.

One dimension: the book's description, sub-aspects and fixed next-step text, the
organisation's readiness score for it and the selected idea's score for it (kept
apart), each with its target, gap and earlier scores.

Every confirmed IQ assessment of one idea, newest first, each compared with the one
before it on the same question set version: change in IQ, Value for Money (same
currency only) and per dimension (spec 9).

Every final readiness result, newest first, each compared with the one before it on
the same question set version: change on the total and per dimension (spec 9).

The organisation's ideas, newest first, each with its latest assessment's IQ and
Value for Money. Compare and sort on the client: every number is already here.

schema.title: Response List Ideas Api V1 Ideas Get

patch.description: Change an idea. Its creator may; so may an owner or admin.

post.description:
Send the idea for scoring. The AI proposes a 1 to 10 score per dimension in the
background (poll the GET until ``proposal_status`` is "ready" or "failed"); the owner
then confirms or changes each one (Amy Q1). Scoring again keeps the earlier confirmed
assessments for history.

get.description:
The proposal beside the owner's review and, once confirmed, the result: IQ out of 100,
levels, category scores, priorities with the book's next steps, Value for Money.

post.description:
Make the scores final. The engine computes the IQ, levels, category scores,
priorities and Value for Money once; nothing about the assessment changes afterwards.

patch.description: Autosave of the owner's review: changed scores (null puts the proposal back) and notes.

post.description: Join the organisation, signed in with the invited email. It becomes the active one.
What the invitation is for. No session needed: the token is the proof.

get.description: Access given to this user's email that has not ended: waiting or active.

schema.title: Response List Consultant Access Api V1 Me Consultant Access Get

post.description:
Accept access given to this user's email. The organisation then appears in the
switcher (``consultant_organisations`` on ``/me``).
Ends every other session; this browser gets a fresh session cookie.

schema.title: Response List Grants Api V1 Organisation Consultants Get

post.description: Give a consultant read-only access until the chosen end date, and email them.

schema.title: Response List Invitations Api V1 Organisation Invitations Get

post.description: Invite someone by email. Inviting the same email again replaces the old link.

schema.title: Response List Members Api V1 Organisation Members Get

post.description:
Any signed-in user may create an organisation. They become its owner, and it becomes
their active organisation.

schema.title: Response List Assessments Api V1 Readiness Assessments Get

get.description:
Everyone's submitted answers, the mean and spread, and the agreed answers so far.
The facilitator's view; individual answers are never shown to anyone else.

patch.description: Autosave: merge these answers into the caller's own; null clears one.

get.description:
The final result: total out of 300 and its band in the book's words, the 12 dimension
scores, category totals, priorities with the book's next steps, and strengths.
The 60 readiness questions, verbatim from the book, grouped by dimension in book order.
The latest explanation of a question in this organisation; 404 if nobody asked yet.

post.description:
Answers "What does this mean?" on a question: the organisation's saved AI explanation,
or a new one on its way (status "pending"; poll the GET until "ready" or "failed").

get.description: The organisation's targets per dimension on both scales, kept apart.
Every change of the targets, newest first: earlier targets are kept.

schema.title: Response Get History Api V1 Targets History Get

put.description: Replace one scale's targets. A dimension left out, or sent as null, has no target.

schema.title: Response Get History Api V1 Weights History Get
